findings.closure: 9f4e142 reads/parses socket frames during hold without acknowledging DATA, limits cumulative flow-controlled bytes including padding to 4096, and rejects end/reset. All four actual rows retain 4096 bytes before/after >2.2s holds and exact full delivery afterward.
findings.finding: The H2 hold stops reading, which can conceal pre-credit DATA queued by a noncompliant peer until after local receive credit is restored. Pump and validate frames without acknowledging DATA during the hold, reject excess/reset/END_STREAM, and record held bytes.

findings.closure: 9f4e142 checks canonical operation UUID, responseVersion1, same item, deterministic SHA256, length and version2, plus independent SQL replay tuple (1,200,actual returned body). All four actual rows pass.
findings.finding: The exact-response assertion currently checks only HTTP200 and nonempty operationId. Bind the actual v1 attachment DTO and SQL-stored response bytes to that returned operation identity.

findings.closure: 9f4e142 adds exact named cases, exit0 and unchanged artifacts. 8736c72 removes the intermediate Evidence.close publication and performs one atomic final save after strict predicates. Nine in-memory policy variants and a publication-failure path pass. Existing four actual successful rows meet all predicates.
findings.finding: An outer post-case exception or between-case interruption can leave Evidence.close reporting passed over only completed cases. Require all three named cases, unchanged artifacts, and no top-level failure before final status passes.
